svg.aria-label: Akshay Redekar, AI/ML Engineer and Inference Engineering. Portfolio page.
svg.text: I have always believed the best learning comes from solving real world challenges, and
that is what has shaped my journey into AI engineering. I love exploring new ideas and
building things from scratch that actually make an impact. I want to be part of taking
something from 0 to 1 or 1 to 100, fully focused on getting it done.
I'm an AI engineer at VE3 in Pune, building agents and retrieval systems. Outside work I'm
studying LLM inference and learning Rust. I'm looking for inference and research
